why: Drawing shows a large applied patch pocket with rounded bottom corners sewn on top of the jacket front; the photo shows a narrow angled jetted/welt slit pocket set into the body with sharp square corners and no applied patch panel.
Both show a horizontal pink buttonhole with a bar tack at the left end and a keyhole eye ending in an arrow/spear-point flourish pointing right; thread color, orientation and tip direction all match.

Drawing is a lime-green wing/check with a short left arm and a long right arm sweeping upward from a bottom vertex; photo reproduces the identical asymmetric two-stroke shape, arm-length ratio and color.
Both show a purple coiled spiral rose at the LEFT end of a horizontal buttonhole slot that terminates in a rounded eye at the right; rose placement side and slot direction match exactly.
Drawing shows a vertical light-blue stem topped by exactly three petal loops (left, center, right); photo shows the same vertical orientation with the same three-petal count and center petal tallest.
Both show a pink vertical stem with two antler prongs branching to the right side only: a tall upper loop and a shorter lower hook; branch side and prong count match the drawing.

Drawing has exactly two colors (purple and pale pink) as two vertical stems each curling into a spiral, purple spiral higher and to the right, pink spiral lower and left; photo reproduces both count and stacking.

Both show a horizontal green wavy stem with hooked ends and a pink three-loop cluster centered above it; the two-color composition and element counts match, though the photo wave amplitude is shallower than the drawing.
Drawing shows a teal double-peak wave with a central dip bridged by a single orange arc; photo has the same two teal peaks, central valley and one orange arc spanning the gap in the same two colors.
Both show a purple treble-clef motif on the same lower-left to upper-right diagonal: pointed loop top right, coiled knot at center, long tail ending in a curl at lower left; slant direction matches.

Drawing is a concentric four-color rosette ordered green center, pink, purple, blue outer ring; the photo shows the same four rings in the identical nesting order with no stems, matching the 4-color count.

Both show a red open-outline heart above two sweeping strokes that cross in an X below it, with the longer tail continuing down to the lower right; stroke count, crossing point and single color match.
